correctness.rationale: Labeled prescribed arrows form closed cycles and open paths, and uniform completion has independent rising-factorial cycle polynomial. The closed-cycle count for a uniform injection [i-1]→[m-1] follows by sequential insertion. Differentiation at t=1 and normalization by Ewens cycle PGF establish the covariance and probability, with R_1 deterministic. Independent enumeration of n≤7 and injections verifies coefficients, not generality.

value.rationale: The explicit joint cycle–record coefficients and positional Ewens law answer a natural dependence question between equidistributed yet non-independent classical statistics on the SAME permutation. The formula supplies every joint coefficient, not merely an isolated low moment.

final_claim: For a uniform permutation of n≥2 and 2≤i≤n, with C its original disjoint-cycle count and R_i original one-line upper-record event, E[t^C R_i]=t^(overline n)/(i n!)+(i-1)t^(overline(n-i))(t-1)^(overline i)/(i n!). Thus Cov(C,R_i)=(i-1)/(i² binom(n,i))>0 and explicit Ewens tilt; total record-cycle Corr∼1/(n log n).
limitations: The claimed polynomial marks one upper-record indicator, not the full record-vector/cycle-type joint law; total covariance asymptotics use the uniform law.
